# Abyssal (abyssal-ocean)

> Photoreal real-time ocean and sky for Three.js: multi-cascade FFT waves,
> physical atmosphere, volumetric clouds with five real cloud genera, GPU
> spray, HDR post. One TSL source compiles to WGSL and GLSL — WebGPU with
> automatic WebGL2 fallback via `createAbyssal()` (one call), or a classic
> zero-dependency WebGL2 adapter. Every subsystem is verified headlessly
> against golden images.

Recommended integration: `import { createAbyssal } from 'abyssal-ocean/webgpu'`
with `three` ≥ r185 (`three/webgpu` build). See AGENTS.md for pitfalls and
verification patterns.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the guide for coding agents — entry points, copy-paste integration, measured pitfalls, per-subsystem verification commands, repo map
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing overview and quick start
- [docs/parameters.md](docs/parameters.md): every parameter, default and range (generated from source)
- [docs/threejs.md](docs/threejs.md): the classic WebGL2 adapter's integration guide
- [docs/physics.md](docs/physics.md): the wave, atmosphere and cloud models and their sources
- [docs/tsl-porting-rules.md](docs/tsl-porting-rules.md): 18 rules for writing TSL that compiles identically to WGSL and GLSL

## Examples

- [examples/webgpu-ocean.html](examples/webgpu-ocean.html): the whole stack in one call, with user meshes sharing depth
- [examples/webgpu-bodies.html](examples/webgpu-bodies.html): OceanBody — drop crates, float hulls, overlapping wakes
- [examples/webgpu-box-ski.html](examples/webgpu-box-ski.html): OceanBody + SKI coefficients — jet-ski GLB that planes; sea dragon as a second OceanBody (`SeaDragon` + `creatureVertex` swim, M to pilot); gravity-wave wake (`wake.physics`) / spray / swell / debug are body properties (Ski / Dragon panels); spray size / life / hull jet / sea state / Sea Dragon live on `abyssal.params` (Sea panel)
- [examples/webgpu-wake-physics.html](examples/webgpu-wake-physics.html): leftover gravity-wave experiment — hull displaces water, crests travel in world XZ and add; plow / hull-speed / hump / plane presets
- [examples/webgpu-sky.html](examples/webgpu-sky.html): sky-only mode with live cloud-genus switching
- [examples/water-and-sky.html](examples/water-and-sky.html): classic WebGL2 adapter, both components
- [examples/index.html](examples/index.html): index of all examples

## Source entry points

- [src/gpu/abyssal.js](src/gpu/abyssal.js): createAbyssal() facade — also the reference for pass order and driver wiring
- [src/cloud-types.js](src/cloud-types.js): cirrus, cumulus, stratus, nimbus, cumulonimbus as measured recipes
- [src/presets.js](src/presets.js): named scene presets and the full parameter set
- [src/three/index.js](src/three/index.js): classic WebGL2 adapter (AbyssalWater, AbyssalSky)
